[A] GridBox / LineGridScene
|
|-- position { column, row }    parent-relative cells
|-- minimumSize? { columns, rows }
|-- collapsed / collapsedContentId?
`-- kind
    |-- diagram                contentId
    `-- container
        |-- children[]         nested GridBoxes
        `-- layout             push-right + gap

Content edit or insertion
`-- measureContent(ascii)
    `-- layoutScene(scene, changedId)
        |-- anchor changed box
        |-- push colliding siblings right
        `-- publish final cell bounds

Insertion: parent-relative; move: absolute cells.
Tree folds do not define grid sizing.
FloatingBoxes consume bounds, never block layout.

[D] Controller edits / agent access
|
|-- UI -> MappingDocumentController
|   |-- prompt patch / generation / paste / grouping
|   |   `-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations[])
|   |-- commitDocument(...)          compatibility document producers
|   |   `-- same coordinated checkpoint path
|   |-- updateCanvas(...)            normally unrecorded view updates
|   `-- undo / redo / reset
|       `-- delegate to DiagramService [M1 source -> E]
|
|-- Agent -> MCP -> HTTP -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |-- QuickJS shadow controller restores captured history
|   |-- live target -> CanvasSessionBridge -> browser applyUpdate
|   `-- proposal target -> ChangeSessionService
|       |-- backend-owned; called by AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|       |-- owns captured/proposed documents and request receipts
|       `-- forks histories; edits/navigates through controllers --> [F]
|
`-- Coordinated update
    |-- check version; clone state; stage commands
    |-- DiagramService.prepareCreate / prepareEdit
    |-- reconcile anchors, folds, sections and layout
    |-- validate; append one checkpoint through DiagramService
    `-- notify readers only after successful append

exec: synchronous QuickJS canvas/nodes methods.
diagram-search: search + full saved/live reads.
canvas-api-search: documentation, not drawn objects.
save_diagram: catalog revision -> explorer + search.

transact(...) remains the atomic MCP adapter to applyUpdate(...).
Failed batches do not advance canonical history.
Measurements do not create checkpoints or increment document version.
Live edits need an open Mapping page; captured proposals are separate.
save_diagram exports full history for whole-document saves.
Single-node saves do not export the source document history.
